versions.changelog: - 显式声明需要的环境变量，以满足安全要求

- 增加安装方式
- 增加常用项目缓存
- 指定从.env需要读取的环境变量，以提升安全性

Initial release of yunxiao-projex: Manage Yunxiao projects and work items from the command line.

- Supports listing projects, viewing user info, searching and managing work items (requirements, bugs, tasks, topics).
- Includes commands for creating, updating, and relating work items via Yunxiao API.
- Allows participant management by name (auto converts to userId), with local user cache support.
- Provides rich CLI examples and configuration instructions for setup.
